ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_costgap_clamped_weightnorm_gapsoftnorm_e1x
ir.intuition: Crossover keeps the shared, stable core from both parents: a Bradley-Terry/DPO-style pairwise -logsigmoid on the log-prob gap (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) with a detached cost-gap margin that shifts the decision boundary without sending gradients through costs. From the more robust parent, we keep alias-based key sourcing (batch then model_output) and safe zeros_like fallbacks to avoid forward errors when some keys are missing. From the more stable scaling parent, we keep (1) clipping the detached cost gap, (2) optional soft-normalization of the clipped cost gap by its mean absolute value to reduce batch-to-batch scale drift, (3) clamping the final logit to prevent saturation/NaNs, and (4) nonnegative weight clamping plus mean-normalized reduction with an epsilon-clamped denominator so loss scale stays stable even with tiny/zero mean weights.
ir.theoretical_basis: Pairwise logistic (Bradley-Terry / DPO-style) loss on the preferred-vs-rejected log-probability gap. A detached cost-gap term acts as a margin/offset without gradients through costs. Clipping the cost gap and clamping the final logit improve numerical stability, and mean-normalized nonnegative weights stabilize loss scale across batches.
